headline: A skipped step read as a successful step four guards deep, and only two accidents held the unattended publish path shut.

items.title: Every downstream guard in the Desk publisher passed when its upstream step was SKIPPED
items.insight: GitHub coerces an empty output and '0' to the same number, so `if: steps.X.outputs.status == '0'` is TRUE for a step that never ran. Run 34063581495 shows the art renderer, the full Desk rebuild, the editorial gates and the public-feed cascade all executing on a slot that drafted nothing. What stopped an unattended commit of a non-edition was an ENOENT crash and the cadence gate -- both look like ordinary bugs, and fixing either alone would have opened the path.
items.evidence: .github/workflows/news-publish.yml · scripts/check-workflow-step-guards.mjs (10/10 self-test, 7/7 negative control on the pre-fix file, 29 workflows clean)

items.title: generate-news-art crashed with a raw stack on the normal dropped slot
items.insight: Unguarded readdirSync on a cache dir that does not exist after a dropped slot. Shipped in the SAME change as #1 and never alone, because it was one of only two things holding the publish path shut. Exit code deliberately unchanged so promotion stays gated.

items.title: The chore filter had never fired: 13 of 24 live public sentences were chore commits
items.insight: `MOVE_VERB[commit.move] || MOVE_VERB[commit.type]` made the explicit `chore: null` unreachable, because chore maps to move `Tended` -> truthy `Refined`. Its own self-test passed on a `move: null` fixture the producer never emits -- the test covered a path production never took. Fixed the precedence and added a structural `visitorFacing` classification a token blocklist could never provide. Feed 24 -> 8.

items.title: The homepage strip I fixed had never rendered, and two theme defects were hiding behind it
items.insight: The digest loads first and stamps vs_last_visit_ts to now before the strip reads the same key, so no entry was ever newer than "last visit". Proved with a control blocking only the digest. Underneath: --vs-text is defined nowhere so every theme took a near-white fallback, and brand gold measured 1.31:1 on cream. 7/7 themes now clear WCAG AA, measured from painted pixels after two computed-style readings were wrong.

items.title: The member newsletter has never sent; both faults proven, execution blocked on a permission
items.insight: Function not deployed (project-scoped 200 lists 29 functions, this one absent) AND NEWSLETTER_SECRET absent from Actions so the cron sends a bare Bearer. Fixing either alone moves 404 to 401. The repair pins the project ref rather than resolving it through the D-S344.1 mismatched slot, which would have deployed this site's newsletter into a sibling tenant.

followUps: Founder authorises the member-newsletter deploy — tooling written and self-tested, blocked only on a sandbox permission.
Founder picks the Desk cadence lever: radar queues 4 topics against 211 rejected, while 4 slots/day x 14-day novelty needs ~56 stories.
Gate the D-S344.6 class: a surface that renders for nobody is invisible to every gate that inspects rendered output.
blockers: The Monthly Member Newsletter is still not deployed and will fail again on 2026-10-02.
The Desk has published nothing since 2026-09-04; cadence is an escalation, not a fix.
Neither headline fix has been observed in a live scheduled run — the next Desk slot is the first real proof.
